QUOTE: HealthMonitor::process_events (health_monitor.cpp:118) takes event_mutex_, swaps event_queue_ into a local vector, releases the lock, then invokes the callbacks on the engine thread. The monitor thread only ever touches the queue under the lock, and callbacks never run under it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the monitor thread queues events under a mutex and callbacks are invoked on the engine (caller) thread via process_events draining.
